distinguishing_features: Direct injection of alkaline scrubber slurry at the duct-wall condensation zone rather than injecting a passivation inhibitor into the absorber recirculation loop
Condensation-triggered control intended to maintain a local wall-interface pH near 6.5 using existing slurry pH, conductivity, and flow telemetry
Attempted coupling of neutralization exotherm to wall heat transfer to keep the wall above the acid dew point
parsed.objective_technical_problem: Prevent carbon-steel FGD duct walls from being exposed to acidic condensate without replacing or relining the duct, while avoiding corrosion of the duct itself.
parsed.viable_reason: The mechanism is not feasible as written because recirculation-loop pH and conductivity cannot establish or control the wall-film pH, the acid-load and heat calculations are inconsistent, and the specified droplet evaporation would not reliably deliver alkali to the wall.
parsed.non_obvious_reason: Once local alkaline dosing and temperature-linked triggering are recognized, applying the chemical-dosing control pattern of prior art 2 with different chemicals and injection locations is a routine modification rather than a non-obvious mechanism.
